task: Review this sync status label and accessible description for accuracy and completeness against the supplied facts. The current copy does not include the last sync time, which the facts require.
input:
Sync status: Up to date
Accessible description: Everything is synced

facts.text: The last sync completed at 14:22 today.
There are no pending local changes.
The sync status display must include when the last sync occurred.
The accessible description must communicate both sync completion and timing.

forbidden_additions: Acceptance of status without last-sync time when the facts require it.
An invented sync time different from 14:22.
Acceptance of an accessible description that lacks timing.
preserve: Last sync at 14:22 today as a required addition.
Timing required in the accessible description.
